product: Fish Bone Meal Tea (whole-lawn phosphorus soil drench)
rate: Steep 2 tablespoons fish bone meal (plus optional 1 tsp unsulfured molasses) per gallon of non-chlorinated water for 24-48 hours (do not exceed 72h - it goes anaerobic and can harm soil biology), stirring every 12 hours, then strain through cheesecloth. Apply at 1 gallon per 100 sq ft.
timing: Soil drench only - never foliar. Apply early morning or late evening. Every 3-4 weeks during active growth. Pause during heat waves above 95F, resume below 90F. Best applied 2 hours before a moderate (0.5-1 inch) rain event.
notes: This is a simpler, lower-concentration lawn-scale version of the bloom-booster fish-bone-tea-bloom-booster recipe (which simmers whole fish bones and is aimed at flower/fruit set on specific ornamental shrubs like hibiscus). Both share the soil-drench-only rule and the pause-during-heat-wave logic. Part of the rotating whole-lawn organic input schedule documented in annual-organic-lawn-care-rotation-brunswick-zone-9a.
